people.name: Anathoth
people.line: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.

people.name: Gallim
people.line: Town in Benjamin; home of Michal's husband Paltiel

people.name: Laishah
people.line: A place near Anathoth and Gallim

translations.web: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
translations.bsb: Cry aloud, O Daughter of Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! O wretched Anathoth!
translations.kjv: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
translations.asv: Cry aloud with thy voice, O daughter of Gallim! hearken, O Laishah! O thou poor Anathoth!
